private_lines.Maya: You are juggling month-end close on the payables ledger while your mum's hip operation is scheduled for Thursday, so you are driving across to Wakefield each evening to sit with her.
private_lines.Tom: You are the one who keeps the supplier invoice spreadsheet, and this week you are covering a colleague's leave by running the stock count at the warehouse in Stanningley every morning before the office opens.
private_lines.Jo: You recently moved from the team's Harrogate office into a two-bedroom flat in Headingley, and you are spending weekends sorting out a dispute with the broadband company over a line that still is not connected.
private_lines.Sam: You are a part-time dental nurse who joined the accounts team on a six-month contract to cover reconciliations, and this week you are also studying for a Friday evening exam in bookkeeping at the Leeds College of Building.

setting: You all live in Leeds and know each other from the small accounts team at a family-run building supplies firm on the Kirkstall Road trading estate, where you have worked side by side for about four years.
